description: Deterministically ensure a nested folder path exists (e.g. 'Courses/2026/Module 1'), creating only the missing segments and returning the leaf folder ID. Idempotent: existing segments are reused. dry_run=true (default) previews which segments would be created.

path.description: Slash-separated folder path by name, e.g. 'Courses/2026/Module 1'

name: panda_action_create_folder_path
title: Create Folder Path
